title: zonetext
summary: MSUI has no zone-entry splash surface. Benilla's ZoneText.xml ships ZoneTextFrame (big zone name + PvP territory line on NEW_AREA), SubZoneTextFrame (26px subzone + FFA line), the FadingFrame fade kit, and AutoFollowStatus. In MSUI the supporting laws exist - FontObjectLaw carries ZoneTextFont(102, cream)/SubZoneTextFont(26) definitions and UiFrameFadeLaw is the transcribed fade state machine - but nothing consumes them: no splash renders on zone change; the only zone text drawn is the minimap header label (Program.Minimap.cs), a different surface.

openItems.text: Zone-name splash on NEW_AREA/INDOORS zone change (fade-in/hold/fade-out) with the cached-zone-text change gate
PvP territory line (Contested / %s Territory / Sanctuary coloring) under the zone name
Subzone splash with its under-the-zone-name seating law and FFA 'PvP Area' line
AutoFollowStatus text (moot until follow exists, but part of this file's surface)
